manifest.name: Bio Cards Addition
manifest.description: A card expansion about life, resource conversion, and chain reactions.

bio:debt.name: Debt
bio:debt.description: At the start of your turn, lose 1[[icon:E]] after normal [[icon:E]] recovery, then remove 1 stack.

bio:extra_healing.name: Extra Healing
bio:extra_healing.description: After recovering [[icon:H]], recover additional [[icon:H]] equal to its stacks. Does not decay.

bio:shield_conversion.name: Shield Conversion
bio:shield_conversion.description: The next time [[icon:H]] would be restored, if the original amount is greater than 0, gain Shield equal to (original amount × Shield Conversion stacks) instead, then clear Shield Conversion.

bio:dna.name: DNA
bio:dna.effect_text: At the start of the target's turn, choose 1 card in their hand with a current [[icon:E]] cost of no more than 4[[icon:E]]. Transform it into a random card from the enabled mods whose base [[icon:E]] cost is exactly 1[[icon:E]] higher, then give it Temporary Swift:1

bio:magic_dna.name: Magic DNA
bio:magic_dna.effect_text: When the target would recover more than 1[[icon:M]], prevent that recovery and have the target recover 2[[icon:E]] instead

bio:rna.name: RNA
bio:rna.effect_text: Each time the target takes actual damage during their own turn, give 1 random card in their hand whose [[icon:E]] cost is not 0[[icon:E]] Temporary Swift:1
bio:rna.description: Life moves at its own pace.

bio:magic_rna.name: Magic RNA
bio:magic_rna.effect_text: Each time the target takes actual damage during their own turn, give 1 random card in their hand whose [[icon:M]] cost is not 0[[icon:M]] Temporary Magic Swift:2

bio:magic_cancer.name: Magic Cancer
bio:magic_cancer.effect_text: When the target plays a Thorn or Bloom card without Exile or Unique, if its actual [[icon:E]] cost is nonzero and the target has at least twice that much [[icon:M]], spend that [[icon:M]] to play an extra copy of that card for free

bio:opal.name: Opal
bio:opal.effect_text: After the target plays their first Thorn card each turn, automatically play the topmost Thorn card in their deck with Temporary Swift:1 if they can pay its cost; otherwise, automatically play an [[card:Light]] with Exile

bio:chloroplast.name: Chloroplast
bio:chloroplast.effect_text: When the target plays a card, give them Shield equal to that card's actual [[icon:E]] cost

bio:blood_chloroplast.name: Blood Chloroplast
bio:blood_chloroplast.effect_text: When the target plays a card, give them Shield equal to the sum of that card's actual [[icon:E]] and [[icon:M]] costs, then deal 2[[icon:D]] to them

bio:blood_knife.name: Blood Knife
bio:blood_knife.effect_text: Deal 5[[icon:D]] to yourself; for every 3[[icon:D]] dealt, recover 1[[icon:E]]

bio:blood_chromosome.name: Blood Chromosome
bio:blood_chromosome.effect_text: For this turn, when you play a non-Magic card with the same name as one you already played this turn, deal 3[[icon:D]] to yourself and recover 1[[icon:E]]
bio:blood_chromosome.description: Let the cycle run a little longer.

bio:hemoglobin.name: Hemoglobin
bio:hemoglobin.effect_text: Apply 1 stack of Extra Healing to the target
bio:hemoglobin.description: Searching for the meaning of life.

bio:job_application.name: Job Application
bio:job_application.effect_text: During the target's next turn, they cannot choose this card's user as a target

bio:indictment.name: Indictment
bio:indictment.effect_text: Convert each instance of physical or electric damage from the responded Thorn card into an equal amount of Shield  Response: Targeted by a Thorn card

bio:ransom_money.name: Ransom Money
bio:ransom_money.effect_text: Deal 5[[icon:D]] to yourself; choose 1 card in your exile zone and move it to your discard pile

bio:high_yield_bond.name: High-yield Bond
bio:high_yield_bond.effect_text: Deal 25[[icon:D]] to yourself, apply 10 stacks of Debt to yourself, and recover 10[[icon:E]]

bio:antibody.name: Antibody
bio:antibody.effect_text: Deal 0[[icon:D]] to the target and apply 1 Fragile

bio:electron_missile.name: Electron Missile
bio:electron_missile.effect_text: Deal 3[[icon:D]] to the target; when it deals actual damage, give every card in the target's hand Charge:1
bio:electron_missile.description: The charge is packed tightly together.

bio:magic_electron_missile.name: Magic Electron Missile
bio:magic_electron_missile.effect_text: Deal 1[[icon:D]] to the target; when it deals actual damage, give up to 3 random cards in the target's hand Charge:1
bio:magic_electron_missile.description: Magic lowers its damage, but gives it the power of life.

bio:sugar.name: Sugar
bio:sugar.effect_text: Deal 3[[icon:D]]×4 to the target (4 sub-petals); each time it deals actual damage, the target recovers 4[[icon:H]]
bio:sugar.description: There is sweetness even in pain.

bio:blood_sugar.name: Blood Sugar
bio:blood_sugar.effect_text: Choose 1: deal 1[[icon:electric_damage]]×5 to the target and 1[[icon:D]]×5 to yourself; or deal 1[[icon:D]]×5 to the target and 1[[icon:electric_damage]]×5 to yourself. After each instance of actual damage, the damaged player recovers 2[[icon:H]] (5 sub-petals)
bio:blood_sugar.description: Shared pain, symbiosis, coexistence. This card's name does not refer to blood glucose concentration.

bio:diamond.name: Diamond
bio:diamond.effect_text: Deal 10[[icon:D]] to the target; when it deals actual damage, play 1 extra [[card:Diamond|flag=wide_strike|flag=self_target|flag=exile|fission=3|swift=2]]
bio:diamond.description: A treasure of the mortal world.

bio:blood_diamond.name: Blood Diamond
bio:blood_diamond.effect_text: Deal 12[[icon:D]] to the target; whenever it deals actual damage, apply 2 stacks of Bleed to the target
bio:blood_diamond.description: A blood mist stains the treasure red.

bio:cyanide_pill.name: Cyanide Pill
bio:cyanide_pill.effect_text: Clear all [[icon:P]] and [[icon:F]] from the target
bio:cyanide_pill.description: Sometimes poison can save a life.

bio:stem_cell.name: Stem Cell
bio:stem_cell.effect_text: Whenever the target actually loses [[icon:H]], this equipment gains stacks equal to the [[icon:H]] lost; after it has been equipped for one turn, pay 6[[icon:M]] and trigger: restore ceil(this equipment's stacks ×75%) [[icon:H]] to the target, then destroy this equipment
bio:stem_cell.description: Do not let your last hope become contaminated.

bio:mitochondria.name: Mitochondria
bio:mitochondria.effect_text: Apply 2 Shield Conversion to the target
